title: Democrats Show Strength in Final Days of Race for the Senate, New Polls Find
summary: Democrats are up in Michigan, Texas, Kansas, Maine and Ohio, have an edge in Alaska and are effectively tied with Republicans in Iowa, new New York Times/Siena polls found.
